source.name: 433FC – Saudi Pro League 2026/27 Shirt Sponsors
source.note: Kit-maker table row: Offside makes the Al-Fateh 2026/27 shirt (the front sponsor was 'TBC' when the article was published on 15 June 2026). The club's partners page lists أوفسايد (Offside) linking offsideksa.com, and Offside's store sells the Al-Fateh 26/27 shirts.

summary: Offside home kit. Al-Asasyah/GREE lockup on the chest centre, Tameeni patch on the right chest, HEALTHY NOOK on the sleeve, Tamweel Aloula and Dallah Hospitals on the back. Other club partners on the club's partners page (Berain, Golden Scent, Al-Tayyar Dates, Sama, Gulf Carton, Al-Jabr Laundries) were not found on the shirt in available photos; shorts not checked, so sponsorsComplete stays false.
